pages.title: Group Play
pages.text: The $(thing)Paladin$() is the only class specifically designed for multiplayer. Healing Aura makes nearby players significantly more durable, and the tanky stats let the $(thing)Paladin$() stand at the front.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Dwarf$() — Fire resistance + heavy armor effectiveness = the ultimate frontliner.$(br)$(thing)Human$() — Versatile bonus adapts to any group role.$(br)$(thing)Orc$() — Attack speed lets you deal respectable damage while tanking.$(br2)$(bold)Next: invest the Fortitude tree ($(k:puffish_skills.open)) — it's built for you.$()
